turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve been having significant shortness of breath, and I have severe chest pain—about 9 out of 10—plus swelling in my calves (right and left). I also had fluid in my lungs.
[ASK] Do you have **fever** (or have you had fever in the last few days)?
[ASK] Do you have new weakness/tingling (especially ascending) or difficulty moving that suggests a neurologic syndrome?
[ASK] Does the patient have shortness of breath (dyspnea)?
Yes—shortness of breath/difficulty breathing in a significant way.
[ASK] Do you have a fever plus a cough with sputum (or shortness of breath) that started within the last 7–10 days?
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) with cough and shortness of breath?
